Dialogs.Dialog: Hello, it's Manaka. Is now okay？
Um, if you'd like... I'm making dinner today, so would you come over and eat？
I'm so glad. Then I'll head home first and wait, so come to my house, okay？
I'm so glad. Then I'll be waiting, so look forward to it, okay？
I see... it was sudden, so it can't be helped. Maybe another time, then.
This is the first time you've eaten at my house, isn't it？
Actually, there's a dish I wanted you to try today. I hope you like it.
I have some ideas already... but do you have any requests？
Then I'll make something I learned recently.
Okay. Then I'll make something I think you'll like.
If possible, I'd like ▲メニュー▲.
Here you go. It came out great, so you can look forward to it？ Just kidding♪
Here you go. I hope it's good...
I messed up a little... but I think it tastes okay, so try it.
I tried adding my own little twist. I hope it tastes good.
I really like this twist I came up with... what do you think？
I tried going for a slightly new flavor. Can you tell？
This dish is a Manaka original, you know？ Hehe♪
The classic taste is nice too, but today I tried changing it up a little.
I tried adding a little twist of my own. How is it？
I'm confident in my Japanese cooking.
My Japanese cooking gets good reviews from Papa and Mama too, you know？
I think Japanese food might be one of my strengths.
Western food usually turns out well for me.
I'm confident in my Western cooking, you know？
Well？ Western food is one of my strengths, so I think it's good.
Chinese cooking has a trick to it, you know？ Hehe♪
I'm confident in my Chinese cooking, so I hope you'll think it's good too.
I put care into how my Chinese dishes look too, you know？ Hehe.
Lately I've been able to make this kind of dish, so I'm happy♪
Is it surprising that I make this kind of food？ It's actually one of my specialties, you know？
How is it？ It's my specialty genre, after all.
I've gotten pretty good at making all sorts of dishes.
I'll make you say "delicious" no matter what I cook♪
Lately, I think I can make just about anything.
Japanese food just doesn't go well for me... If love alone made it work, I'd be confident of a perfect score, though...
I... might be a little bad at Japanese food. But it's packed with love, okay？
Japanese food is so delicate and hard... maybe I just feel like I'm bad at it？ But I tried hard, so please try it.
I'm trying in my own way... but I can't quite grasp the key to Western food.
Western food seems easy but it's actually hard. Maybe I just lack the knack...
For some reason, I struggle with Western dishes. Please understand I still made it with all my heart...
Getting the steps right for Chinese food is hard... I wish love alone could get me through.
I can't get the seasoning right for Chinese food... even though I follow the recipe...
I just can't get the hang of Chinese food. How is today's...？
This dish... is actually a little hard for me. But I made it with all my heart, okay？
I'm doing my best, but I'm not confident with this type of dish...
How is this dish？ I'm not that good at it... so I'm a little worried.
Somehow, I can't get the flavor right no matter what I make. I'm not confident... but I'd be happy if you ate it.
Cooking is so hard... I wish I could make a dish I'm confident serving you.
The key point of today's dish is, um... is love alone not enough？
Look, these dishes. They match yours, you know？ Let's take good care of them♪
I really love having dishes that match yours.
Ahh, I'm stuffed. Thanks for the meal.
(I feel like it gave me some good energy.)
It was nothing special♪ How was it... I'd like to hear what you think.
Um, can I hear what you think？ Today, I think it came out well, if I do say so myself...
So, how was it？ I have a feeling I'll hear something nice today♪
How was it？ Can I hear what you think？
(I think it was on the good side...)
If you don't mind, I'd like to hear what you think.
Sorry... it wasn't that great, was it？
I'm sorry... it wasn't good, was it？
I'm scared to hear it... but maybe I'll ask？
I'm so happy！ When you praise me like that, it makes me want to try hard again♪
Huh!? Really... so that was okay？
It was pretty good, I think.
I see. Then... should I be happy？
Really!? I thought it was a failure...
The taste... wasn't really my thing, I guess.
Really？ I was confident about it... I should rethink it.
This kind of flavor... isn't quite my taste.
I see... it wasn't that great after all, was it？ I'll study cooking harder.
It wasn't quite like ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s usual... maybe.
You're being considerate... I'll try harder and make something delicious next time, so wait for me, okay？
Hey, do you ever feel like eating something other than bento for a change？
I'd still rather have your bento.
Really？ Then I'll make you another one♪
Yeah, I think going to the cafeteria would be a nice change of pace.
I see, that might be nice too.
Um, what do you usually do for breakfast？
Then... how about I come make you breakfast？ If it's not a bother.
You know, can I come make you breakfast again？
If ▲高嶺＊＊▲ is offering, maybe I'll take you up on it.
I'm so glad. Then I'll come over next time.
Right... it might be uncomfortable having me come over first thing in the morning.
You know, lately I've been making a lot of sweets. Would you try some, if you'd like？
I'm so glad. Then I'll make something delicious, so look forward to it♪
Um... can I come to your place to make dinner again？
I'd be the one asking you to.
Really？ Then I'll come make it next time♪
That's... I'll try to make it myself.
I see... cooking for yourself is important too.
